title: Data and coding materials for: From Sensing to Anticipation on the Phone: A PRISMA 2020 Systematic Review of Player-Affect Modelling in Mobile Games
description: Search records (identifiers only), screening decisions, coding forms, the 59-variable codebook, human-human and human-LLM agreement analyses, and the 151 included reports with their codes, for a PRISMA 2020 systematic review of player-affect modelling in mobile games. Abstracts, author keywords, verbatim quotations and full texts of third-party reports are not included.
